title: decouple-sampling-timer-and-introduce-kernel-hedge-for-smoother-first-byte-latency
author: Jesse Morgan
release_notes: Introduce an asynchronous sampling timer separated from the emitter loop and a lightweight kernel hedging path to reduce first-byte latency variance in streaming workloads. No user-facing API changes.
description: Background: streaming token emission has exhibited spikey TTFB under mixed workloads where emitter-driven sampling interferes with kernel availability. Prior work focused on credit shaping and flush cadence; this change takes a different angle: separate the sampling/timer logic from the emitter runtime path and introduce a short-lived kernel hedge that opportunistically runs on spare cycles to reduce tail jitter. Motivation: reduce first-byte variance for short/interactive prompts without increasing steady-state cost. Design: 1) decouple the sampling timer (sampling.ts) into an independent async scheduler that maintains sampling cadence but does not block the emitter main loop. This avoids emitter stalls when sampling waits on I/O or internal locks. 2) add a lightweight kernel-hedge executor that can pre-emptively run a 1-2 token forward pass on a compatible quantized kernel when device utilization drops below a small threshold; the hedge is priced by a per-device microcredit so it doesn't run under tight capacity. 3) introduce graceful backoff: if the hedge finds the main kernel busy, it yields and signals the emitter to increase emergent flush urgency. 4) observable knobs added: hedging_enabled, hedge_util_threshold, hedge_credit_cost, async_sampler_window. Benchmarks: internal A/B on a mixed-production trace (single-token-heavy interactive sessions) shows median TTFB unchanged, 95th reduced by 18-24% across p40 and a100 variants, and 99th reduced by 12-16% with <2% increase in token CPU/GPU cycles across traces. Safety: hedge will not run on models flagged for deterministic execution; default config disabled for Dedicated plans unless enabled by ops. Rollout plan: staged rollout via feature flag for 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2 weeks, monitor TTFB and unit-cost. Changeset summary (high level): - runtime/sampling/async_scheduler.{ts,cpp}: split timer and sampling responsibilities, new async scheduler with bounded queue. - runtime/hedging/hedge_executor.cpp: new lightweight hedging executor and microcredit accounting. - runtime/metrics/hedge_metrics.{h,cc}: new metrics and tagging for hedged vs normal emissions. - runtime/config/schema.yaml: feature flags and default values. - tests/streaming/hedge_integration_test.cc: unit and integration tests for hedging/backoff. Implementation notes: kept changes local to runtime package, attempted minimal API exposure to avoid upgrade surface. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked in Linear ENG-1142 - [x] unit tests added - [x] integration test against mixed trace harness - [x] metrics and tracing hooks - [x] feature flag gated and disabled by default on Dedicated - [x] rollout plan and rollback steps included in description Related work: builds on ENG-1050 (credit shaping) and complements ENG-1167 (adaptive-flush tune).

b7d9e2a: add hedge executor and microcredit accounting
c2f44f1: hook metrics and feature flags; update config schema
review_comments: Ava Patel: Overall approach LGTM. Can you clarify how hedge_credit_cost maps to existing credit accounting? Suggest adding a small e2e trace showing when hedge runs.

Jesse Morgan (author): Hedge credits are a separate micro-credit bucket charged only when hedge_executor runs; implementation deducts from device.micro_credits. Added e2e traces to integration test and a runbook note.
Miles Chen: Two requests: 1) ensure hedging cannot run for models marked deterministic; 2) please add an observability tag for 'hedge_skipped:busy_kernel' so we can correlate.
Jesse Morgan: added deterministic-model guard and hedge_skipped tag in metrics. Updated tests to cover both behaviors.
Riley Thompson: CI flakes on test streaming/timeout in first run; re-ran and green. Approving once CI stable.
Ava Patel: Approved after minor nits addressed.
notes: This PR intentionally keeps hedging conservative: defaults off for certain plans, deterministic models never hedged. Ops runbook added at docs/ops/hedge-runbook.md describing feature flag toggles and metrics to watch (ttfb.p50/p95/p99, hedge.count, hedge.yield_rate).

changelog_entry: runtime: add async sampler and optional kernel hedging to reduce streaming first-byte latency variance (config: hedging_enabled=false by default).
additional_context: Related perf PRs adjusted flush cadence and credit shaping. This change reduces interference between sampling and emission loops and provides a lightweight, conservative mitigation when kernels are underutilized.
